 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Prabhat Ranjan  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Nirmal Kumar Sinha  Mr. Jharkhandi Upadhyay  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 5 10-04-2025 Heard the parties.
2. This application has been filed for quashing the FIR bearing Buddha Colony P.S. Case No. 419 of 2019 registered for the offence under Sections 406, 420, 120(b) and 506 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the opposite party no. 02 that the charge-sheet has already been submitted in this case.
4. In view of the above, this application has become infructuous now and the same is accordingly dismissed.

(Sandeep Kumar, J) Vikas/-
